description: This file defines a static class providing build and version information about the MigraDoc rendering component, including Git version, branch name, commit date, and assembly target platform details.

classes.name: MigraDocRenderingBuildInformation
classes.description: A static class that exposes properties related to the build environment and versioning of the MigraDoc renderer.

methods.name: GitSemVer
methods.description: Returns the semantic version string derived from Git version information.

methods.name: BranchName
methods.description: Returns the name of the Git branch during build.

methods.name: CommitDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the last commit.

methods.name: AssemblyTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the assembly's title attribute value.

methods.name: TargetPlatform
methods.description: Returns the target platform name, differing based on the .NET version.
